about_the_game:
Welcome to GOO Prototype Labs

A state of the art, one of a kind product testing facility, entirely automated by the most highly advanced robotic testers. GOO Prototype Labs has released many well acclaimed products, from the Anti-Wrinkle De-age Cream to the GOOp Gun! Witness the most advanced lab money can buy, watch our test bots work 23 hours a day, 7 days a week, and behold science at peak efficiency.

Our Brand New Products: The Goo Series!

Currently in the works is our highly advanced Goo series of products! Compatible with the GOOp Gun, the Goo series promises high utility, multi-purposed liquid materials to assist in any task. Bounce heavy objects into the air using our Super Springy Frog Bouncing Goo! Speed along the ground with our Mega Cheetah Speed Goo! Or secure objects in place for a lifetime using our Ultra Durable CocoCrab Sticky Goo. The possibilities are as endless as your imagination.

Our Test Robots: Reliable, Durable, and Well Tested

Here in GOO Prototype Labs, we task only the most well tested of robots to ensure the functionality, utility, and most importantly, safety of our products. Every product is tested by our most advanced test robots from the B3 line, Meanwhile, every product test is overlooked by the highly intelligent and every aware managerial J1 line. Our prime testing duo is B3-R and their managerial overseer J1-M, who are hard at work testing our brand new Goo series! Trust that our quality is left in good, metallic hands.

Wait what do you mean B3-R is escaping? Wait, are we still being recorded? HEY CUT THE RECORDING!!!

content_descriptors.notes: The content in our game is very light in terms of mature content. The game does have themes of workplace abuse and managerial misconduct, however it contains no foul language, no overt violence, and no mature themes of any kind. This is intended to be a game for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to GOO Prototype Labs, a state of the art testing facility of the future! Take the role of B3-R in this old school 3D puzzle platformer and attempt to free yourself using the brand new GOO Product Line! But remember, your every action will be watched and judged by the managerial staff.
